caption:
Donald Trump expressed openness to negotiating with Democrats after initial vetoes.

During an interview with the New York Post following the midterm elections, US President Donald Trump stated he plans to veto incoming Democratic proposals but expects eventual negotiations. He also expressed interest in meeting Democrat Abdul El Sayed, who floated the idea of renaming a universal healthcare plan as Trumpcare, according to Al Jazeera.

The shift in tone follows aggressive campaign rhetoric and comes as Democrats take control of Congress, making bipartisan cooperation essential for key legislation.
